verdict.summary: PR #425 at 16f4cd060660f772b0cb7b8e07bc3abd46ca5afc remains blocked by two required-check trust-boundary gaps.

blockingFindings.title: Policy checks are authenticated only as generic GitHub Actions runs
blockingFindings.details: For marius-patrik/DarkFactory PR #425 at head 16f4cd060660f772b0cb7b8e07bc3abd46ca5afc, every policy-selected check is bound only to ACTIONS_APP_ID. A head-controlled workflow can therefore emit successful jobs named Validate or DarkFactory Autoreview under the same app ID, and a single such run is accepted as trusted evidence. The expected state is provenance tied to the base-trusted workflow or another immutable check identity, not merely its mutable name and shared Actions app.

blockingFindings.title: Collision detection examines only the first 100 check runs
blockingFindings.details: The check-runs request fetches one page with per_page=100 and neither paginates nor rejects truncation. An untrusted head can produce more than 100 Actions check runs so that a forged successful required-name run is visible while the authentic same-name candidate is on a later page; evaluateRequiredChecks then sees one matching candidate and reports green instead of ambiguity. Fetch complete evidence or fail closed on pagination, with a regression test crossing the 100-run boundary.
